<DOCSTRING>
Manages a collection of users and processes them based on their age.

This class is responsible for maintaining a list of users and processing each user to determine if they are an adult or a minor. It is used by the system to handle user data and perform age-based actions.

@attribute {User[]} users - The list of users managed by the UserManager. This array is initialized when the UserManager is created and is modified by the `addUser` method.

@method {void} addUser(user: User) - Adds a user to the `users` array and processes the user using the `process` method.

@method {void} process(user: User) - Processes a user to determine if they are an adult or a minor. Logs the result to the console.
</DOCSTRING>
